{{Top|leg}}
A '''cyberfuse''' was a small device that used minimal [[Computer/Legends|computer]] programming to anticipate power surges and shut down electrical current to a given circuit. It prevented [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components from being damaged by excessive energy from the ship's power core.
